correctness.rationale: The twelve coordinates have exactly squared distances 2,4,6,8. At squared threshold 2 the eight triangular maximal simplices have cube-graph nerve, giving \(\bigvee^5S^1\). At 4 the triangular faces and six square-face tetrahedra have the same good-cover nerve as the cuboctahedron boundary, giving \(S^2\). At 6 the only missing edges are six antipodal pairs, so the clique complex is the join of six copies of \(S^0\), hence \(S^5\); at 8 it is the full simplex. Fresh exhaustive reconstruction independently gives face/Betti data (12,24,8)/(1,5,0), (12,36,32,6)/(1,0,1,0), and (12,60,160,240,192,64)/(1,0,0,0,0,1), corroborating the homotopy proof.
